\"The APK signature input allowance\".reason: The 512 MiB whole-APK read is a resource policy; the content digest needs the whole file.

\"The apktool version-output capture all.reason: Bounds the reply to `apktool --version`, a short fixed-format banner; no analysis input passes through it.

ceiling.name.reason: Projects the boot-image parser's own named ceiling (`ceiling.name`); the value is declared by that parser.

\"The auditd log file-size ceiling\".reason: The 4 GiB auditd log admission is a resource policy; issue #11345 tracks giving it a control as the reader grows past step 1.

ceiling.name.reason: Projects the sparse-image parser's own named ceiling (`ceiling.name`); the value is declared by that parser.

\"The Image4 DER depth allowance\".reason: Bounds Image4 DER recursion. Real IMG4 nests well under 32 levels; the cap is the call depth.

\"The Image4 DER element allowance\".reason: Bounds TLV fan-out. A payload octet string is one element and is not loaded.

\"The Image4 property allowance\".reason: Bounds retained manifest rows. Real manifests are far smaller than 256 properties.

\"The Image4 string allowance\".reason: Bounds one IA5, UTF8 or PrintableString retained as text.

\"The Mega Drive ROM byte ceiling\".reason: The linear cartridge window this reader admits is 8 MiB. A larger file needs a mapper this reader does not decode.

\"The Mega Drive SMD block ceiling\".reason: An SMD dump is the same program image in 16 KiB blocks after a 512-byte copier header, so 512 blocks is that 8 MiB ceiling.

\"The Nintendo 64 ROM size allowance\".reason: Retail cartridge masks stop at 64 MiB (512 Mbit). A larger file is refused before its bytes are swapped. This release has no runtime override, and artifact_limits.expanded_bytes does not raise it.

\"The Nintendo DS ROM directory depth al.reason: Bounds FNT directory nesting (64 levels) so deeply nested 127-byte directory names cannot expand a single path prefix to ~512 KiB before member path retention.

\"The Nintendo DS ROM expanded path allo.reason: Bounds aggregate UTF-8 bytes of expanded FNT member paths (16 MiB) before allocation so 61,440 files under deep prefixes cannot expand an 8 MiB FNT into gigabytes of retained path strings.

`The ${parserLimit.name} allowance`.reason: UBI eraseblock size and count allowances are resource policies; the static payload CRC budget is derived from the admitted image length.

\"The wxapkg directory-and-chunk I/O wor.reason: Four times the admitted member count plus 64 KiB chunks of declared member bytes, which artifact_limits.expanded_bytes bounds; it grows with that admission.

parserLimit.name.reason: Projects a Deno parser limit declared at its owner (`parserLimit.name`).

\"The Deno compile virtual filesystem de.reason: Bounds nested walkEntries recursion so a deeply nested VFS JSON cannot exhaust the call stack; entry, name and path budgets are per-call artifact_limits.deno controls.

\"The .NET bundle exact integer range\".reason: A bundle offset or size above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER cannot be represented exactly as a JavaScript number.

\"Node SEA duplicate-blob verification a.reason: Duplicate-blob verification work is bounded by the carrier's own file size, so the bound grows with the admitted input.

\"The web-bundle worker transfer allowan.reason: Web-bundle worker transfer bytes are a resource policy.

allowance.reason: Relays the live runtime-retention allowance its caller names.

\"The Playwright trace ZIP expansion all.reason: The ZIP reader's plaintext-work budget is derived from the admitted trace archive's own size, which trace_limits.archive_bytes bounds.

DEB_PACKAGE_FIXED_ALLOWANCES[cause.allow.reason: Reports the Debian parser's named ar name, tar extension, relationship alternative, Zstandard window, or XZ dictionary allowance using the parser's maximum.

text(recovery.fixedAllowance.name).reason: Copies a declared fixed allowance while redacting its text; declares no ceiling.

\"The analysis-view projection allowance.reason: The analysis-view projection allowance is a resource policy.

`The GraphQL AST nesting allowance of ${.reason: Bounds the parsed AST depth that REA's recursive selection-set generators (collectSelections, nested yield*) and graphql-js's recursive print and schema building walk, so a deeply nested document cannot exhaust the call stack or make nested generator delegation quadratic.

allowance.reason: The fixed-ceiling helpers themselves; each caller names its own allowance.

fileSize ? \"the Electron fuse input all.reason: Electron fuse input bytes and sentinel inventory are resource policies.

\"The Flutter APK expansion allowance (d.reason: Expansion work is derived from the admitted APK's own size.

\"The header parser's exactly representa.reason: An executable extent above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER cannot be represented exactly.

\"The Ghidra installation-properties rea.reason: Bounds Ghidra's own Ghidra/application.properties, a short key=value installation descriptor of the bring-your-own provider (about 1 KiB); no analysis input passes through it, and a larger file is not a Ghidra installation REA can drive.

\"The Ghidra C type depth allowance\".reason: Ghidra 12.2 stores, names and compares a data type recursively through its pointer, array, typedef and member chain; measured on Ghidra 12.2, 1024 levels resolve and 2048 exhaust the JVM stack inside addDataType while its database lock is held, leaving that lock held and the Program unusable. No caller value can raise the stack, so the bound is a quarter of the last measured safe depth.

\"The GPU nesting allowance\".reason: Bounds recursive GPU container nesting (8 levels in GpuInventory.ts) and AMDGPU MessagePack value nesting (32 levels in AmdGpuMetadata.ts) to prevent unbounded call-stack recursion.

\"The GPU parser syntax allowance\".reason: Fallback fixed parser syntax ceiling (such as 128 tokens per PTX parameter declaration) so unmapped parser BinaryResourceFailure values stay inside the Result error contract.

{ ...outputLimit.ceiling, narrowing: \"R.reason: REA bounds each stdio message from the upstream IDA MCP server at a fixed frame size; the transport, not the analysis, sets it.

`The IPS ${name.replaceAll(\"_\", \" \").reason: Native reader structural, text and inventory allowances are resource policies without a per-call control.

\"The retained DWARF section bound\".reason: Retained file-backed sections cannot exceed the admitted image size; the bound is the selected file and grows with it.

\"The whole-file debug candidate read al.reason: The streamed candidate is hashed in bounded chunks; its 0xffffffff-byte whole-file ceiling states no format reason, so it is a policy awaiting a control or a stated reason.

text ? \"The ELF dependency text budget.reason: ELF dependency entry allowances are resource policies; the text budget is derived from the admitted image length.

ELF_NOTE_TEXT_ALLOWANCE.reason: The note text, hash and scan budget equals the admitted image length plus its decoded section names, so it grows with max_file_bytes and needs no control of its own.

\"The ELF unwind symbol-name text allowa.reason: The 16 MiB symbol-name text decoded for one returned page is a resource policy; a smaller page (limit) stays within it.

\"The binary hardening table-entry allow.reason: The ELF dynamic table entry count is a resource policy; symbol-table excess already degrades to unresolved rows.

\"The lipo field retention allowance\".reason: lipo fields are sliced from its captured output, and their retention is bounded by the same native command output allowance; it changes only with that capture allowance.

\"The native plist input allowance\".reason: Native reader structural, text and inventory allowances are resource policies without a per-call control.

\"The native plist nesting allowance\".reason: The decoded plist value nests inside Evidence JSON, whose depth is bounded by MAX_JSON_DEPTH before recursive result cloning; three levels are reserved for the report envelope (MAX_NATIVE_PLIST_NESTING_DEPTH = MAX_JSON_DEPTH - 3).

`The native ${encoding} plist decode all.reason: Native reader structural, text and inventory allowances are resource policies without a per-call control.

\"The packet-tool output capture allowan.reason: Bounds only capinfos and tshark version and summary probes, whose replies are short fixed-format text; each tshark JSON pass reports producer_limits.output_bytes instead.

\"The packet-inventory retained-fact all.reason: tshark JSON decoding, expansion, retained-fact, output and snapshot allowances are producer budgets.

\"Sensitive terminal redaction\".reason: Sensitive terminal redaction state is a resource policy.

ceiling.name.reason: Relays the whole-file identity ceiling its caller names: 4 GiB minus one byte for the PE-only readers and the Mach-O function-starts reader, whose file offsets (PE fields, LC_FUNCTION_STARTS and LC_DATA_IN_CODE dataoff, FAT32 slice offsets) are 32-bit (format), and the 512 MiB artifact-size bound of the hardening and exports result schemas. max_file_bytes, a per-call parameter with details.limit, bounds what the readers read.

`The SQLite worker diagnostic capture al.reason: Bounds stdout and stderr of REA's own SQLite worker, which answers through its reply file; only startup failures and runtime warnings reach these streams, and no database content or analysis result passes through them.

\"The SQLite value/record, SQL statement.reason: The 16 MiB value/record, statement and worker reply allowance bounds what the parent decodes from REA's SQLite worker; it is a resource policy that should become a per-call control together with the worker heap.

\"SQLite's result-column limit for this.reason: SQLite's own result-column limit (SQLITE_LIMIT_COLUMN) for the private connection, reported by the engine with the reply; REA does not set it.
